after.text: Confirmed against v0.15.0-rc.4 source: internal/stateread/stateread.go ReadRegularFile uses Lstat and refuses any non-regular seed (environments spec §8.4.1, path must be a regular file), so the rc.4 binary refuses the symlinked ~/.codex/config.toml by design. A full run in an isolated HOME also needs an installed profile; the source read was used instead, because the owner real ~/.curator is off-limits. Tier 2 per tb-keeper: Gate A primary composition would refuse at cutover on machines with the agents-management symlink layout. Preferred fix (tb-keeper): admit a same-owner symlink that resolves inside HOME, opened without following further links, with the target recorded. This needs a spec amendment of environments §8.4.1, an owner-level security boundary change.
